The .sframe format version

Source: R/read_write_sframe.R
SFRAME_FORMAT_VERSION.Rd

The version written into every file as sframe_format. It tracks the shape of the serialised object. The package version and the instrument's own version are separate. Bump it only when the file's structure changes in a way a consumer must react to. sframe-schema conformance profiles are keyed to this value.

Usage

SFRAME_FORMAT_VERSION

Value

A character scalar containing the current .sframe format version.
